summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for building a Firebase-powered backend with a web admin panel for the Bharatiyam Gratha Sudha app. Covers 4 phases: Phase 1 - Firebase setup with Firestore content database, Phase 2 - Web admin panel for content management (add/edit stotras), Phase 3 - Premium/free tier system with content locking, Phase 4 - User authentication and client monitoring/analytics. Includes detailed Firestore schema, admin panel features, app-side changes, and future roadmap.
